stock.description: Infinity Logistics and Transport Ventures Limited, an investment holding entity, provides a wide array of logistics solutions across an extensive international network, including operations in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Netherlands, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, and Vietnam. The company's operations are divided into several key segments: Integrated Freight Forwarding: This division handles both non-vessel operating common carrier (NVOCC) functions and general freight forwarding services. Logistics Centre Services and Related Offerings: This segment encompasses warehousing facilities, container depot management, and comprehensive container services such as storage, upkeep, and repairs. It also offers value-added processes like labeling and repackaging. Land Transportation Services: Focuses on rail and road transport. Flexitank Solution and Related Services: Specializes in providing flexitank solutions and associated support, including expert consultation, installation, and emergency response, for the transportation of bulk non-hazardous liquids. 4PL Services: This segment delivers end-to-end fourth-party logistics (4PL) and handling services, which involve managing orders, ensuring legal compliance, overseeing warehousing, and coordinating supplier relationships. Additionally, it offers packing, crating, and haulage. Established in 2003, Infinity Logistics and Transport Ventures Limited is headquartered in Klang, Malaysia, and functions as a subsidiary of 2926 Holdings Limited.
